duration.text: The Advertising at Wuhan University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3652 USD/per year ￥ 26300 CNY/per year

materials.text: Certificate of HSK HSK 6 Certificate or notarized version. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents Postgraduate school transcript

requirements.text: Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport; Under the age of 45; Have attained a Master's degree
